body:
Quick mode — no voting panel. Rounds 1-3: up to 6 Cursor specialists in parallel (plan-fidelity when plan available) + generic Codex. Main agent reviewed findings across 1 round.

Round 1: 6 Cursor specialists + Codex reviewed. Accepted 3 findings (validate-citations.sh setsid FD3 bug, eval-research.sh --help before quiet init, validate-research-output.sh --help before quiet init). Rejected: larch-logs commits (by design), ship-pr.sh bundling (pre-existing from prior run), FAILURE_LOG doc wording (follows existing pattern). Fixed nit: deny-edit-write.sh comment.
